findings.message: The param pessoaOrganizacaoId selects a record but no public selection method existed; added selectPessoaOrganizacao(id | null), which publishes selectedPessoaOrganizacao and reads the record through obterPessoa (null clears pessoa).

buscarPessoas takes busca and situacao but no state holds them; added filtroBusca and filtroSituacao (transient, reset on every visit) and made buscarPessoas(options) publish them and load from the first page.

The entry param empresaId (select:acoesLiberacao, persisted) has no state; added selectedEmpresaId so it is read from the URL/localStorage, persisted, and carried by irPrepararEmpresa (empresa.id wins when loaded). The docId param of empresa is not held by this page and is not carried.
A fresh abrirPessoasOrganizacao replaces the list but the contract has no route to refresh a selected pessoa; pessoa is only refreshed by obterPessoa.
public filtroBusca is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public filtroSituacao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public selectPessoaOrganizacao is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
public selectedEmpresaId is not declared by the defs; the shared added it so the pages can drive the page (a draft, a setter, a selection or a filter state).
